neighbours.notes: Cold step-in reader of bonsai1/L30/N3237- (drop 0.14). Card flags it dense (10% of tokens >0.1 max) and positional (top peaks in the first 16 tokens). Probes: plain English sentences 0.18-0.33 with no special word (twins with/without complement-taking words tied); code, JSON, SQL, math 0.04-0.19; Spanish prose ~0.26, German/French ~0.08. Solver found no leak. Test sentences written blind by a second author from the label only.
